about_the_game:
Demon Lord Army Set 4 is a high-quality collection of enemy battler images and matching face graphics.

This set features a wide variety of enemies, including Skeleton Warriors, Skeleton Wizards, Skeleton Kings, different types of Zombies, Lizard Kings, Lizard Wizards, Kobold Kings, Griffins, Demon Kings, and many more.

Contents:

●     50 enemy battler images (both standard and large sizes, for front-view battles)
●     135 total images with color variations (including some unique palette versions)
●     126 enemy face graphics

-------------------

・This pack is for use in RPG Maker Series or the engine of your choice.

・OK to be used in Commercial projects made in RPG Maker

・You may modify some of the assets (but not redistribute them) for your own game use only.
